flavor: Sunlight pours through high, crystalline clerestories, illuminating a garden of white marble and singing fountains. In the center, a creature of shifting, prismatic smoke drifts through a cage of solid radiance, its many eyes reflecting the noon-day sun.
name: The Gilded Menagerie
reason: A celestial-touched entity resides here, offering cryptic prophecies in exchange for prayers or sanctified relics.
